hero_h2: Trade NFTs through the official marketplace app
hero_lead: looksrare is the official NFT marketplace for exploring collections, buying and selling NFTs, making offers, and accessing rewards through its live app.
what_is: LooksRare is a community-first NFT marketplace for buying, selling, making offers on, and browsing digital collectibles. The official LooksRare Docs cover marketplace guides, developer resources, token information, rewards, and protocol contracts.

how.d: Go to the official domain and confirm looksrare.org before connecting a wallet.
Use a supported wallet or WalletConnect, then review each signature request before approving.
Search collections, compare listings, offers, activity, and item details inside the marketplace.
Buy listed NFTs, make offers, list owned NFTs, or open Rewards from the same app.

points.p: The app brings collection discovery, buying, selling, offers, raffles, and rewards into one official destination.
The aggregator documentation describes buying ERC721 and ERC1155 tokens from multiple marketplaces in a single transaction.
Docs list developer resources, deployed contracts, public API references, SDK materials, and published audit links.

faq.a: looksrare is used to explore NFT collections, buy listed NFTs, make offers, sell owned NFTs, and access marketplace-related rewards through the official app.
The official app is hosted at looksrare.org; verify the domain carefully before connecting a wallet or signing any transaction.

faq.q: What wallet do I need for looksrare?
faq.a: LooksRare supports wallet connections through WalletConnect and compatible crypto wallets; always review signatures and network prompts before approving.

faq.q: Can I buy and sell NFTs on looksrare?
faq.a: Yes. The official marketplace includes guides for buying fixed-price NFTs, making offers, listing NFTs for sale, and accepting offers.
No. Marketplace pages, rankings, rewards, and token references are informational; evaluate NFT risks, contract prompts, and liquidity before acting.
